title: St. Vincent–St. Mary vs. Walsh Jesuit — Football (2025–2026)
summary: St. Vincent–St. Mary Fighting Irish vs. Walsh Jesuit Warriors — 2025–2026 high school football game photography. Photography by Mason Bybee.
article_headline: St. Vincent–St. Mary Meets Walsh Jesuit Under the Lights
article_dek: A photographic look back at the Fighting Irish and Warriors on the football field.
article_body:
A high school football game is shaped by drives, defensive adjustments and sideline communication. When St. Vincent–St. Mary and Walsh Jesuit meet, those details become part of a Northeast Ohio football story.

The images in this gallery emphasize athletes in motion and reactions between plays. Mason Bybee’s photos serve as the primary account rather than an invented play sequence.
